description: P1 dead-code census (E3). Per-surface {status, evidence, authorizes} ledger, re-derived against the post-#3921 src/** tree. Evidence is concrete and reviewer-checkable; the oracle re-verifies every entry (tests/architectural/_p1_census_oracle.py). Dead surfaces authorize a base-red drop (WP03) or coverage-denominator exclusion (WP05/WP15). Live entries are pinned (E4 committed membership) so a live surface cannot later be relabeled dead.

surfaces.note: Sync transport retired in The Convergence (#115). Banned import prefix in tests/architectural/test_no_retired_subsystems.py; the retirement gate is independent, reviewer-checkable evidence.
Delivery subsystem retired with the sync transport. Banned import prefix; enforced always-on by the retirement gate.
In-repo saas subsystem retired; SaaS is now an upstream client repo (saas_client is the live consumer). Banned import prefix.
Event-journal subsystem retired with the sync transport. Banned import prefix; retirement gate enforced.
Egress + egress_consent modules retired. Banned import prefix; retirement gate enforced.
The websockets transport dependency was retired; the retirement gate bans the import prefix. Excluded from the coverage denominator.

LIVE post-#3921: imported by runtime/next/{decision,runtime_bridge_composition,next_invocation_lifecycle}.py, review/gate_registry.py and skills/manifest_store.py.
